submission.reasoning: On workstation5, an interactive cmd.exe session (proc-23dc9b1636, PID 8836, running as WORKSTATION5\wardog) wrote C:\Users\wardog\AppData\Local\Temp\art.bat at 02:46:45. About 23 seconds later, at 02:47:08, the same cmd.exe started reg.exe (proc-55d9f85e37) with the command line 'REG ADD HKCU\Environment /v UserInitMprLogonScript /d ...\Temp\art.bat /f', running at High integrity. That set HKU\...-500\Environment\UserInitMprLogonScript to the new batch file. Windows runs this value at each logon, so this is logon-script persistence (MITRE T1037.001). The batch file has the Atomic Red Team naming ('art.bat'). The graph does not show whether the script has run yet. Response: remove the registry value, delete art.bat, isolate workstation5 and check the wardog account.
